source.author: verg
source.text: labitur exsanguis, labuntur frigida leto lumina, purpureus quondam color ora reliquit.
source.text_original: labitur exsanguis, labuntur frigida leto / lumina, purpureus quondam color ora reliquit.
source.text_english: He slips away, bloodless; his cold eyes slip to death, the purple hue that once was on his face has left it.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: in media iam morte senes suffectaque leto lumina et undanti revomentes veste cruorem conspiciunt; primoque rudem sub limine rerum te, puer, et visa pallentem morte parentum diripiunt adduntque tuis.
reuse.text_original: in media iam morte senes suffectaque leto / lumina et undanti revomentes veste cruorem / conspiciunt; primoque rudem sub limine rerum / te, puer, et visa pallentem morte parentum / diripiunt adduntque tuis.
reuse.text_english: Already in the midst of death, they see old men, their eyes replaced for death, and, with garments streaming blood, spewing it back; and at the first threshold of your life, you, boy, still unformed, and pale from the death of your parents as they were seen, they snatch away and join you to their own.
